name: Ice Wall · Fire
primary: A 5×3 wall at the aim point, across your view at any angle, each column settling on the ground. Look up to raise a gabled tent roof over you instead, 9 wide and 5 long with open ends. Material: ice, melts after 30 s.
self_description:
A 5×3 wall at the aim point, across your view at any angle, each column settling on the ground. Look up to raise a gabled tent roof over you instead, 9 wide and 5 long with open ends. Material: ice, melts after 30 s. On you:
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
